name: Japanese Dense Web
summary: Dense pages with many links, small type, bright accent colours, banners, ranking lists and tight grids. It grew from portals such as Yahoo! JAPAN and Rakuten and makes a page rich in choice.

philosophy.core_thesis: Density is hospitality: show all the options at once, so the visitor never has to search.
design_principles: Pack 6 to 12 content blocks above the fold, each with a title row of 28px to 32px and 5 to 10 links beneath.
Set text at 12px to 14px with a leading of 1.5 to 1.7; keep headings at 14px to 18px and bold.
Use a tight grid with 8px gutters and block padding of 8px to 12px; borders of 1px in light grey separate blocks.
Mark categories with bright accent colours (red #E60012, orange, blue #0A58CA) in 3px to 4px header bars.
Show ranking numbers (1 to 10), price, discount badge and star ratings in small bright elements of 12px to 16px.
Add 3 or more banners of 300px to 728px width in rows, and a sticky bar for search and cart of 48px to 56px height.
Keep a clear text-first path: every block has a text link, and images are small thumbnails of 64px to 120px.
anti_patterns: Large empty hero sections with one headline
Single call to action per screen
Thin light type at 16px or above for everything
Hidden navigation behind a single menu icon
Monochrome palettes with no accent colours

layout.grid_mechanics: A modular grid of 4 to 6 columns with 8px gutters; blocks of 160px to 320px width stack in rows; side columns of 180px hold categories and rankings.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 5% to 15% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 12 and 16px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left; numbers right-aligned; tags and badges inline; banners centred in their row.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 0px to 4px radius and a 1px border in #DDDDDD; header bars of 3px to 4px colour above blocks.

font_pairings.note: A single family with full Japanese coverage for tight small text.
A friendlier gothic that stays clear at 12px.
A Latin and CJK pair for mixed text.

typography.tracking: Tracking stays at 0 to +0.02em; small text takes +0.02em.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and bold (700).
Set the titles of blocks at 14px bold.
Set prices in bold red at 16px to 20px.

color.palette_structure: White ground with bright category colours and red for price and promotion.
color.contrast_rules: Ink on paper holds 16:1; red on paper holds at least 4.5:1 for 14px bold and larger; link blue holds at least 7:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat, opaque fields; small gradient on a header bar or button is allowed (2 stops).
color.light_and_shadow: None; a 1px grey border separates blocks.

materiality.surface_simulation: Print flyers, catalogues and magazines, shown flat on screen.
materiality.border_rules: 1px solid #DDDDDD around blocks; 3px to 4px colour bars on headers.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur. No elevation. A 1px shadow only on sticky bars.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Small 16px to 20px solid or outline pictograms with a 1.5px stroke, used as inline labels; badges and arrows in text.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Product thumbnails, banners, character mascots and ranking badges in flat colour.

motion.transition_physics: Little motion; banners cycle every 5s with a 300ms slide; hover changes the link colour at once.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover underlines a link and turns it red (#E60012); active state darkens a button by 10%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels abundance, convenience and a sense that everything is at hand.

avoid_when: The brand needs a premium, calm look.
The page has one task and one action.
The audience reads on a very small screen with big type needs.

modifiers.how: Cut to 3 blocks, raise type to 16px and set 24px gutters; keep one red accent.
Put blocks in cells with a 12px radius and a 1px border; keep the density.
Add pastel fills and squiggle patterns to the header bars.

pack.why: A compact, solid family that stays clear at 16px beside 12px to 14px text.

ground.why: Dense Japanese portals sit on a ruled grid with a colour bar across the top.
